propositions: The deterministic link checker must enforce top-level docs index membership and validate repository-relative Markdown links against a maintained source boundary.

Relative links and images resolve from source directories to any target inside the repository; targets escaping the repository produce deterministic findings with source path, line number, raw target, normalized target path, and failure reason.

The checker includes declared source patterns (.agents, .github, docs, examples/agent-skills, infra, scripts, src/rebar/_guides, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs, templates, tests) and excludes .joe-janitor, .rebar/prompts, src/rebar/llm/reviewers, and test fixture directories.
Scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, fenced code blocks, inline code spans, and reference-style links are ignored; query strings and fragments are stripped before file resolution.
The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve is replaced with the expanded checker API.
docs/documentation-policy.md documents the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions.
